lines.en: Hi, Mia. The main office told me this morning that your parcel would arrive today.
lines.pt: Oi, Mia. A central me disse hoje de manhã que a sua encomenda chegaria hoje.

lines.en: That’s strange. A woman called me and told me that the delivery would be late.
lines.pt: Que estranho. Uma mulher me ligou e disse que a entrega atrasaria.

lines.en: Really? Did she say why it would be late?
lines.pt: Sério? Ela disse por que atrasaria?

lines.en: She said that the van was broken, and that the driver was ill.
lines.pt: Ela disse que a van estava quebrada, e que o motorista estava doente.

lines.en: Oh, I see. My manager told me that the driver was at the doctor’s today.
lines.pt: Ah, entendi. Minha gerente me disse que o motorista estava no médico hoje.

lines.en: So she told me the truth. She also told me that I could collect it here.
lines.pt: Então ela me disse a verdade. Ela também me disse que eu poderia retirá-la aqui.

lines.en: Yes, you could. She told us that we should keep it until you came.
lines.pt: Sim, poderia. Ela nos disse que deveríamos guardá-la até você vir.

lines.en: Good. A neighbour told me that he would collect it, but he was out.
lines.pt: Bom. Um vizinho me disse que ele a retiraria, mas estava fora.

lines.en: Don’t worry. My friend at work told me that your box was already on the shelf.
lines.pt: Não se preocupe. Minha amiga do trabalho me disse que a sua caixa já estava na prateleira.

lines.en: Wonderful! She told me that it would be here by noon, and it is noon now.
lines.pt: Maravilha! Ela me disse que estaria aqui ao meio-dia, e agora é meio-dia.

lines.en: Here it is. I told you that it would be easy, and it was.
lines.pt: Aqui está. Eu disse que seria fácil, e foi.

facts.big: She told me it would be late
facts.label: Discurso indireto
facts.sub: Use told me + that + would: She told me that the delivery would be late.

facts.label: me disse que
facts.sub: Use told me that + frase para contar o que alguém disse: She told me that the parcel would come. Você precisa dizer a pessoa: told me, told him, told us.

facts.label: Um passo atrás
facts.sub: No discurso indireto, o verbo volta: is vira was, can vira could, will vira would. Exemplo: “It will be late” vira She said it would be late.

compare.ask: She told me it would be late.
compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “Ela me disse que a entrega atrasaria”.
compare.tip: Diga: “She told me it would be late.”
compare.us: Em inglês, use told me + that + verbo no passado: She told me that the delivery would be late. Use would no lugar de will. Say usa sem pessoa: She said that…

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.
group: Leia as duas colunas e peça que apontem a maior diferença.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: She told me that it would be late is reported speech.
We say “She told that it would be late.”
items.why: We say She told me that it would be late.

items.s: After told me, the verb often goes into the past.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: She told me that it would be late is reported speech. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “She told that it would be late.” → Falso (We say She told me that it would be late.)
After told me, the verb often goes into the past. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A late delivery in Leeds · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a busy Saturday in Leeds. Sara comes into the post office. She holds a card from the courier. Eli works at the counter. Many people wait for their parcels. Sara wants to know the truth.

“Hi, Sara. The main office told me this morning that your parcel would arrive today.” says Eli. “That’s strange. A woman called me and told me that the delivery would be late.” says Sara. “Really? Did she say why it would be late?” says Eli.
